name: urbancandy-monorepo
description: Monorepo for UrbanCandy project (Backend, Frontend, AI)

scripts.lint:check: npm run lint:back && npm run lint:front
scripts.quality:check: npm run lint:check && npm run test:back && npm run test:front && npm run test:email
scripts.build:check: npm --prefix UrbanCandy_back run build && npm --prefix UrbanCandy_front run build && npm run build:email
scripts.pre-pr-check: npm run quality:check && npm run build:check
